name: webhook-retry-engine
description: Caygnus Webhook Retry Engine - reliable webhook delivery with idempotent ingestion, persistent scheduling, bounded retries and real-time observability

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/client install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client & wait
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/client run build
